commands: $ths=@(); Get-Website | ForEach-Object { $_.Bindings.Collection | Where-Object { $_.protocol -eq 'https' } | ForEach-Object { $h=[string]$_.certificateHash; if ($h) { $ths += $h } } }; $thumb=($ths | Group-Object | Sort-Object Count -Descending | Select-Object -First 1).Name; "dominant cert thumb=$thumb"

$wc = '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><configuration><system.webServer><rewrite><rules><rule name="all404" stopProcessing="true"><match url=".*" /><action type="CustomResponse" statusCode="404" statusReason="Not Found" statusDescription="Not Found" /></rule></rules></rewrite></system.webServer></configuration>'; if ($hasRewrite) { Set-Content -Path "$root\web.config" -Value $wc -Encoding UTF8; 'web.config(404) written' } else { 'NO rewrite module; / will be 403.14, sub-paths 404' }

if (-not (Get-Website | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq $site })) { New-Website -Name $site -PhysicalPath $root -Port 80 -HostHeader $fqdn -Force | Out-Null; 'site created' } else { Set-ItemProperty "IIS:\Sites\$site" -Name physicalPath -Value $root; 'site existed; path repointed' }

if (-not (Get-WebBinding -Name $site -Protocol https -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.bindingInformation -match ":$([regex]::Escape($fqdn))$" })) { New-WebBinding -Name $site -Protocol https -Port 443 -HostHeader $fqdn -SslFlags 1; 'https SNI binding added' } else { 'https binding already present' }

$s=Get-Website | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq $site }; "VERIFY name=$($s.Name) state=$($s.State) path=$($s.PhysicalPath)"; $s.Bindings.Collection | ForEach-Object { "  $($_.protocol) $($_.bindingInformation) hash=$([string]$_.certificateHash)" }
netsh http show sslcert hostnameport=s4.eightfoldway.com:443 | Select-String 'Hostname|Certificate Hash' | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim() }
curl.exe -s -o NUL -w "probe sni=s4 http=%{http_code} sslverify=%{ssl_verify_result}`n" --resolve s4.eightfoldway.com:443:127.0.0.1 https://s4.eightfoldway.com/
